facts.fact: KRAY 晚上 7:30 坐在伦敦骑士桥伯克利酒店 Blue Bar 最右侧，把外套搭在旁边椅子上给 LIFTSHITS 占座。
facts.anchor: The Blue Bar, The Berkeley Hotel, Knightsbridge, London, England, 7:30 in the evening. KRAY is sitting at the bar, over on the far-right side, turned in his chair, observing the room. He has his coat draped over the chair next to his, reserving it for LIFTSHITS.

facts.fact: LIFTSHITS 自称 Ralph，说 Howard 提过 KRAY 大概更愿意用 Funny Name；KRAY 回称自己是 Andre。
facts.anchor:
“LIFTSHITS, Ralph,” LIFTSHITS says in a low voice. “Howard said you would probably prefer to stick to Funny Names.”

“KRAY, Andre,” says KRAY.

facts.fact: LIFTSHITS 点 Maker’s Mark Manhattan：straight up、perfect、柠檬皮、苦精、不加樱桃；KRAY 说听起来不错，要了两杯。
facts.anchor:
“Maker’s Mark Manhattan, straight up, perfect, twist of lemon, bitters, no cherry,” says LIFTSHITS.

“Angostura?” says the bartender.

LIFTSHITS nods.

“That sounds good,” says KRAY. “Two, please,” he tells the bartender, who nods.

facts.fact: LIFTSHITS 说他在 1982 年刚开始工作不久就认识 Howard，两人当时都抽大雪茄，在 Bubble 外的长椅旁偶遇。
facts.anchor: “Oh, right after I started, in ’82,” says LIFTSHITS. “We were both big cigar smokers back then. Ran into each other by chance on one of the benches out by the Bubble.

facts.fact: KRAY 说监视目标是他的 Division Chief P. Richard Wacker；LIFTSHITS 低声脱口而出，说自己厌恶此人。
facts.anchor:
“My Division Chief,” says KRAY. “P. Richard Wacker.”

“Dick Wacker!” LIFTSHITS blurts out in a half whisper. “God, I despise that guy. I’m liking this more and more.”

facts.fact: KRAY 把 Cooper 给的伦敦 Funny Name 告诉 LIFTSHITS，LIFTSHITS 想了一下摇头，说从没听说过她。
facts.anchor:
KRAY tells LIFTSHITS the London name from Cooper. LIFTSHITS turns it over in his mind, then shakes his head.

“Never heard of her.”

facts.fact: LIFTSHITS 临走说今晚还有约，一名巴基斯坦朋友称 bin Ladin 藏身巴基斯坦并能说出地点；随后让 KRAY 转告 Howard 别忘了欠他的五十美元。
facts.anchor:
Anyway, I have another meeting I need to get to tonight. A Pakistani friend whispered to me the other evening that bin Ladin is hiding out in Pakistan. He says he can tell us where.”

He takes a step away, then turns back.

“Tell Howard I haven’t forgotten about that fifty bucks he owes me,” he says.

facts.fact: KRAY 掏出三张二十英镑钞票，问侍者有没有别的出口离开。
facts.anchor: “I need to see a man about a dog,” he says, displaying three twenty-pound notes. “Is there some other way out of here?”
